Inspect, plan and reconcile native packages conservatively

Usage: pkgx [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  demo         Browse synthetic packages without native tools (read-only)
  managed      List explicit APT management grants (never inferred from installed state)
  manage       Grant or forget strict-mode management of a concrete installed APT package
  search       Search existing native metadata (provider-specific query syntax)
  info         Inspect package records; non-APT adapters require an installed package
  why          Report native installation reason and its provenance limits
  deps         Inspect installed native dependency expressions without resolving a graph
  install      Preview or confirm an installation (execution supports APT and Pacman)
  remove       Preview or confirm a removal (execution supports APT and Pacman)
  plan         Preview a qualified package operation or a resolved manifest
  export       Export installed identities to an additive TOML manifest
  diff         Report provider-scoped manifest drift without changing packages
  apply        Reconcile an additive manifest after plan review and confirmation
  tui          Open the package browser (read-only unless --allow-apply)
  audit        Inspect native orphans, caches and residual records; never deletes anything
  clean        Preview cleanup, or run native cache cleanup / reviewed orphan removal
  recipe       Check, verify, install and track script recipes (explicit trust required)
  completions  Print Bash, Zsh or Fish completion definitions
  history      Read transaction records; missing results are running or unknown
  providers    Detect provider binaries and available adapter capabilities
  doctor       Report provider diagnostics and interrupted/unknown journal entries
  list         List installed packages from an explicitly selected provider
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json                   Print versioned JSON results (export and completions emit native text)
      --sudo                   Use sudo only for confirmed APT/Pacman transactions and cleanup; previews stay unprivileged
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>  Dedicated private transaction directory; inspection never creates it
      --profile <PROFILE>      Select a manifest profile; repeat to compose several profiles
  -h, --help                   Print help
  -V, --version                Print version
